description: This Java class 'JavaSyntaxChecker' reads code snippets from a JSON file, optionally wraps incomplete snippets into a full Java class structure, and uses JavaParser to check for syntax errors, outputting the results as JSON.

classes.name: JavaSyntaxChecker
classes.description: Main class that reads code snippets from a JSON file, wraps incomplete snippets, and checks Java syntax errors.

classes.name: CodeSnippet
classes.description: Data class representing a code snippet with file path, language, and code content.

methods.name: main
methods.description: Entry point of the program; processes command-line arguments, reads code snippets, performs syntax checking, and outputs JSON results.

methods.name: removeImports
methods.description: Removes import statements from a code snippet using regex.

methods.name: cleanSnippet
methods.description: Wraps code snippets into a full Java class if they are not already complete, and removes import statements.

methods.name: readCodeSnippets
methods.description: Reads a list of CodeSnippet objects from a JSON file.
